title: Threshold Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum energy E_0 must be correctly calculated as 12 M_p c^2.

title: Velocity Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The velocity v/c of the psi' particle must be correctly determined as 12/13.

title: Invariant Mass Equation
description: Important Criteria: The use of the invariant mass equation must be correctly applied in the calculation of E_0.

title: Center of Mass Frame
description: Important Criteria: The concept of the center of mass frame must be correctly understood and applied in part (b).

title: Energy-Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The conservation of energy and momentum must be properly referenced in the context of the reaction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The units used in calculations should be consistent and correctly converted where necessary.

title: Final Answer Format
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should be clearly stated in the required format.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes in energy calculations must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Missing factors in the energy-momentum equations can lead to incorrect results.
